entries.title: Rich nations must cut debt as global shocks push up borrowing costs, IMF chief tells BBC
entries.summary: In an interview with the BBC, Kristalina Georgieva says economic shocks had pushed "debt levels up like a staircase not to heaven".
entries.title_zh: 国际货币基金组织总裁告诉 BBC，随着全球冲击推高借贷成本，富裕国家必须削减债务
entries.summary_zh: 克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃在接受英国广播公司采访时表示，经济冲击已将“债务水平推高，就像阶梯一样，而不是通往天堂”。

entries.title: As Trump and Xi talk, China surges ahead with its AI ambitions
entries.summary: The BBC visits Inner Mongolia, where Beijing's AI infrastructure is progressing at "China speed", says one worker.
entries.title_zh: 特朗普和习近平谈话时，中国正在大力推进其人工智能雄心
entries.summary_zh: 一名工作人员表示，BBC 访问了内蒙古，北京的人工智能基础设施正在以“中国速度”发展。

entries.title: 'Extremely dangerous' Hurricane Polo intensifies to rare category 5 storm
entries.summary: The storm's sudden intensification off the coast of Mexico is "truly remarkable", the US hurricane monitoring agency said.
entries.title_zh: “极其危险”飓风波罗加剧为罕见的 5 级风暴

entries.title: Will Trump's AI rebrand to 'super intelligence' catch on?
entries.summary: Some people close to the president have started to use the term but experts say it is unlikely to catch on.

entries.summary_zh: 一些与总统关系密切的人已经开始使用这个词，但专家表示这个词不太可能流行起来。

entries.title: Child ketamine users in UK getting bladder damage describe 'peeing a jellyfish'
entries.summary: Doctors running the UK's first and only dedicated NHS clinic for children with ketamine bladder say they are seeing patients as young as 13.
entries.title_zh: 英国儿童氯胺酮使用者膀胱受损，描述“在水母上撒尿”
entries.summary_zh: 英国第一家也是唯一一家专门为氯胺酮膀胱儿童提供服务的 NHS 诊所的医生们表示，他们接诊的患者年仅 13 岁。

entries.title: India is producing more green energy - but wasting a lot of it
entries.summary: India has rapidly decarbonised electricity generation, but its gains are tempered by transmission shortages.
entries.title_zh: 印度正在生产更多的绿色能源，但也浪费了很多能源
entries.summary_zh: 印度已迅速实现发电脱碳，但其成果因输电短缺而受到抑制。

entries.title: Europe's car makers are in crisis. Will the threat of war rescue them?
entries.summary: Auto executives across Europe hope rearmament can help them flex their industrial muscles once more.
entries.title_zh: 欧洲汽车制造商正陷入危机。战争的威胁会拯救他们吗？
entries.summary_zh: 欧洲各地的汽车业高管希望重整军备能够帮助他们再次展示其工业实力。

entries.title: 'I don't have a buoyancy aid': Living without the Bank of Mum and Dad
entries.summary: Three 20-somethings tell BBC News how they are navigating life without parental support.

entries.summary_zh: 三个 20 多岁的年轻人告诉 BBC 新闻，他们如何在没有父母支持的情况下度过生活。

entries.title: I was close to joining Liverpool in 2016 - Mbappe
entries.summary: Kylian Mbappe says his mum was a "big fan" of Jurgen Klopp and wanted her son to move to Merseyside.

entries.title: Pollock left money on table to stay at Saints - Hearn
